posts.description: The idea of creating this blog has been floating around my head for more than a year. A place to write, share my ideas, and be a part of the wider web community again. My goal for this blog is simple. I want to write for me, about any topic that interests me. Most likley this blog will talk about technology, gaming and other related topics.
